svg.title: Tub Surround measurements
svg.desc: Full photograph with backer, both niche openings, complete bathtub and current floor; dimensions are source observations, not scaled from the photograph.
svg.text: Inches · Niche measurements use the front opening edges
≈ approximate · Calculated gaps inherit approximate readings. Photo is not to scale.
71¼″: tub rim to backer top · 22″: current photo floor to rim · ≈33″: back wall to outer front.
Niche vertical dimensions start at the tub rim; top gaps end at the top of the backer.
